entry has an associated Time-To-Live (TTL) value. Entries expire after a

- Uses a dictionary mapping keys to nodes for O(1) lookup.

from collections import OrderedDict

    """A node in the internal doubly linked list.

    This class represents a single cache entry. It holds the key, the value,
    and the timestamp at which the entry was created (creation_time). The
    ``access_time`` is updated on every access and is used to determine
    whether an entry should be evicted due to TTL expiry.

    Attributes:
        key: The unique key under which the entry is stored.
        value: The cached value.
        creation_time: Timestamp when the entry was initially inserted.
        access_time: Timestamp when the entry was last accessed.
